macro.label: VIX: 15.84
macro.text: S&P 500 at 7,656.98. The VIX touched 17.84 Thursday and gave back most of that Friday. In the mid-15s, normal strike distances are fine this week.

macro.label: Odds of a Wednesday rate rise: about 90%
macro.text: Up from near 61% before Thursday's producer price report. With the move mostly priced in, don't open a new position in the hour before 11:00 AM Pacific Wednesday; place it after the decision is out.

macro.label: Friday is quarterly expiration
macro.text: A closing imbalance can decide an at-the-money strike either way in the final hour. Decide what you want for any in-the-money short option and act on it Thursday.
